title: Price-snapshot store: opening and closing numbers for every originated market

contract.unit: one row per game, per market, per capture point
contract.reject_rule: a row may not be written without all four required fields; an assumed price is not accepted in any column

policy: empty by design until the owner decides the price-data policy (requirement R04 / F-01)
